This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures to pressure the opponent early on while controlling the board with removal spells and disruptive creatures. The combination of cheap creatures like Faerie Mastermind and Spyglass Siren, along with control options like Cut Down and Sheoldred's Edict, allows for quick aggression while maintaining control of the game. This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on using a combination of low cost creatures and control spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Floodpits Drowner, Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, and Spyglass Siren provide early pressure, while cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down help maintain board control. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Phantom Interference and Faerie Mastermind to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse serves as a powerful late-game threat to close out the game. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to win before the opponent can stabilize.

The core strategy revolves around playing aggressive creatures and powerful spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Utilizing cheap spells and card selection, the deck aims to maintain a high tempo while dealing damage efficiently. Key components include powerful instant speed burn spells like Torch the Tower and Rebel Salvo, alongside efficient creatures like Vivi Ornitier and Stormchaser's Talent. Ral, Crackling Wit provides card advantage and reach, while Agatha's Soul Cauldron offers disruption and additional damage. The deck's mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while maintaining a good balance of red and blue sources.
